load_object_nav_dataset_from_json: load an ObjectNav-v1 dataset from a JSON string with optional scenes directory path
serialize_object_nav_dataset_to_json: serialize an ObjectNavDatasetV1 instance to a JSON string preserving goals by category
deduplicate_object_nav_goals: deduplicate goals across episodes in an ObjectNav dataset by grouping them by goals key
deserialize_object_nav_goal: deserialize a serialized ObjectGoal dictionary into an ObjectGoal with AgentState view points
review_object_nav_dataset_class: review the ObjectNavDatasetV1 class that inherits from PointNavDatasetV1 for object navigation tasks
